title: 第11章 我对现在的妻子很满意
slug: 前任渣我五年闪婚他哥被宠成宝
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

他们一出现，草坪上的目光几乎全都落了过来。

低声议论很快响起。

“那就是阿辞带回来的太太？”

“听老爷子说，他回国没多久就领证了，之前一点风声都没有。”

“这姑娘什么来头？看着不像本地几家的小姐。”

“气质倒是不错，难不成是他从国外带回来的？”

那些目光落在时夏禾身上。

打量，探究，审视。

她指尖微微收紧，却没有躲。

为了今天这场家宴，她昨晚跟着视频学到凌晨。

站姿、称呼、餐桌礼仪，能补的都补了一遍。

她知道自己不是这个圈子里的人。

可今天，她是祁晏辞带来的祁太太。

不能怯场，更不能拖他后腿。

时夏禾深吸一口气，脸上扬起一个得体的笑。

这时，一道略显刺耳的男声响起。

“小辞回来了？”

一个中年男人走过来，脸上带笑，眼底却没什么温度。

他先扫了眼祁晏辞，又慢悠悠看向时夏禾，语气轻慢。

“结婚这么大的事，也不提前跟家里通个气。你外公年纪大了，突然听见消息，难免要替你操心。”

“这位祁太太的家世、人品，你都摸清楚了吗？别一时兴起，什么人都往家里领。”

时夏禾心里咯噔了下。

祁晏辞却只淡淡看了对方一眼。

“二舅刚从海边回来？”

中年男人一愣：“什么？”

祁晏辞语气寡淡：“不然怎么管这么宽。”

空气瞬间一静。

周围几个人差点没憋住笑。

二舅脸色一下难看起来。

“你——”

话还没出口，另一道苍老却有力的声音便传了过来。

“小辞。”

众人纷纷让开。

一位拄着拐杖的老人站在不远处，头发花白，背却挺得很直。

他看着祁晏辞，眼底隐隐有些发红。

“小辞回来了就好，这些年在外头受苦了。”

祁晏辞眉眼间的冷意淡了些。

“外公。”

他带着时夏禾走过去。

老人看了他许久，又将目光落在时夏禾身上。

时夏禾立刻乖巧开口：“外公好。”

老人神情复杂地看着她，最终只是叹了口气。

“小辞，你跟我去书房一趟。”

说完，他朝旁边一个二十出头的女孩招了招手。

“念念，你陪你表嫂去花园走走。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

As soon as they appeared, almost all the eyes on the lawn fell on them.

Whispers soon began.

"Is that the wife A Ci brought back?"

"I heard from the old man that he got the certificate not long after he returned to China. There was no news at all before."

"What is this girl's background? She doesn't look like any of the local ladies."

"The temperament is pretty good. Could it be that he brought it back from abroad?"

Those eyes fell on Shi Xiahe.

Consider, investigate, examine.

She tightened her fingertips slightly, but did not hide.

For today's family dinner, she followed the video until the early hours of the morning last night.

Standing posture, address, table manners, everything that can be made up has been made up.

She knew she was not from this circle.

But today, she is Mrs. Qi brought by Qi Yanci.

You can't have stage fright, let alone hold him back.

Shi Xiahe took a deep breath and raised a decent smile on his face.

At this time, a slightly harsh male voice sounded.

"Xiao Ci is back?"

A middle-aged man came over with a smile on his face but no warmth in his eyes.

He first glanced at Qi Yanci, then slowly looked at Shi Xiahe, his tone was scornful.

"It's such a big deal like getting married, but I don't inform my family in advance. Your grandpa is old and he will inevitably worry about you when he suddenly hears the news."

"Have you figured out Mrs. Qi's family background and character? Don't accept anyone from your home on a whim."

Shi Xiahe's heart skipped a beat.

Qi Yanci only glanced at the other party lightly.

"Second uncle just came back from the beach?"

The middle-aged man was stunned: "What?"

Qi Yanci said in a calm tone: "Otherwise, why would we be so lenient?"

The air became silent for a moment.

Several people around him could barely hold back their laughter.

The second uncle's face turned ugly.

"You——"

Before the words were spoken, another old but powerful voice came over.

"Little words."

Everyone got out of the way.

An old man with a cane stood not far away. His hair was gray but his back was straight.

He looked at Qi Yanci, his eyes slightly red.

"It'll be good if Xiao Ci is back. I've been suffering outside these years."

The coldness between Qi Yanci's brows and eyes became lighter.

"Grandpa."

He walked over with Shi Xiahe.

The old man looked at him for a long time and then turned his attention to Shi Xiahe.

Shi Xiahe immediately said obediently: "Hello, grandpa."

The old man looked at her with a complicated expression, and finally just sighed.

"Xiao Ci, come with me to the study."

After speaking, he waved to a girl in her early twenties next to her.

"Niannian, please accompany your cousin-in-law for a walk in the garden."
